'''Cavvie''' was the [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of [[Karn (settler)|Karn]] and his [[Karn's wife|wife]]. She settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]] with her family, including her [[Tallov Kersk|uncle]] and [[Tallov Kersk's wife|aunt]] and cousin [[Vettle]]<ref name="RKD" />&mdash;in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> The family were the first settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] to encounter the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Muza]].<ref name="RKD" />
